niche: R&B, Afrobeats and Hip-Hop artist — authentic vocal-led music with feel-good and moody late-night energy, influenced by Chris Brown, Tory Lanez and Justin Bieber
contentStyle: Raw vocal clips perform best. Mix of feel-good energy and moody atmospheric moments. Behind-the-scenes studio life, reaction moments, snippet drops before release, personal storytelling. Formula: emotional hook (raw vocal or relatable line) → story/context → build anticipation → call to stream or follow. Seasons matter — summer bangers vs moody autumn/winter late-night vibes.
targetAudience: 16-28 R&B and Afrobeats fans in the UK, people discovering new artists, fans of Chris Brown / Tory Lanez / Justin Bieber energy, young Black British music lovers
appDescription: Content and growth OS for Thierno (Bras) — R&B, Afrobeats and Hip-Hop artist from Portsmouth, Northampton and London. Manages content strategy, release pipeline, stream tracking and fan engagement.
bestFormula: Raw vocal or emotional moment → personal story → build anticipation → stream / follow CTA
onboardingTagline:

aiGreeting: Hey Thierno! I'm your ArtistOS AI. I know your sound — R&B, Afrobeats, Hip-Hop. Ask me for content ideas, release strategy, caption help, or upload a clip and I'll tell you how to make it hit.
goals: Consistent posting, 3-4 new songs released in 6 months, growing streams and engagement, building a genuine core fanbase. National growth first, then continental, then global.

biggestChallenge: Content quality and consistency. Raw vocals perform best but not posting enough of them. Self-managed — the outward creative side is draining when the heart is really in the music.
